BETA Close X Serco Group plc has announced further transactions under its share buyback program, purchasing a total of 527,155 ordinary shares on April 1st and April 2nd, 2026. The average price paid per share was approximately 290.33 pence, with purchases ranging from 288.00 pence to 293.40 pence. Following these transactions, Serco's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 998,118,543. The total number of voting rights, also excluding treasury shares, is the same, serving as the denominator for shareholders' notification obligations. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 02 April 2026 02 April 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 01 April 2026 267,155 289.4619 288.0000 291.0000 02 April 2026 260,000 291.1732 287.8000 293.4000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 998,118,543 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 4,627,471 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 02 April 2026 is 998,118,543 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 4,627,471 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
